description: Delek US Holdings operates as an integrated downstream energy company in the United States, with business activities spanning refining and logistics. Founded by Israel’s Delek Group in 2001, Delek now owns only a small stake in its U.S. spinoff. Delek US processes crude oil and other feedstocks to produce gasoline, diesel fuel, aviation fuel, asphalt, and other petroleum-based products, distributing these through both owned and third-party terminals. Delek US owns and operates refineries in Texas, Arkansas, and Louisiana with a combined nameplate crude throughput capacity of 302,000 barrels per day. Its logistics operations encompass the gathering, transportation, storage, and marketing of crude oil, intermediate, and refined products, as well as water recycling services for third parties. Delek US serves a diverse customer base, including oil companies, independent refiners and marketers, distributors, utility and transportation companies, government entities, and retail fuel operators.

rankings.itemDescription: Delek is a diversified energy company, with a portfolio encompassing petroleum, asphalt, convenience store retail, and more, much of it acquired via acquisitions in the first decade of the century. Like many energy companies, it's coming off a shaky 2020; Delek reported a first quarter 2021 net loss of $98.6 million, less than the $307 million net loss in the same quarter last year.
